children: jumped 10.7% in Thursday's trading as Oppenheimer initiated coverage with an Outperform rating and a $7 price target, seeing the company as transitioning from a defense microdisplay supplier into a multi-vector defense display/optical company with business expanding into drone goggles, augmented night vision, and optical interconnect.

Oppenheimer analyst Martin Yang's bullish thesis rests on three pillars: strengthening core defense demand, expansion into FPV drone goggles and augmented night vision, and a fundeddevelopment of microLED optical interconnect for AI data centers.

Yang said he expects higher-value optical systems and in-house OLED manufacturing to improve product margins as new programs enter production and believes the transition toward broader product revenue and sustained operating profitability supports a premium, with successful commercialization of emerging applications offering upside beyond his forecasts over the medium term.
revenue reaching $90M in 2028, representing a 31% compound annual growth rate from 2025, with operating profitability beginning in 2027.

title: Kopin initiated Outperform at Oppenheimer on path to higher-value defense growth
